{"answer":"I think checkout restarted because it ran out of memory. The evidence points that way but doesn't prove it. At 11:53:20 UTC on 2026-11-01 the service logged "processing cart batch of 5000 items". Twenty seconds later, at 11:53:40, it logged a fatal error saying the JavaScript heap was out of memory. Memory use kept climbing after that, from about 88% at 11:58 to about 96% at 11:59 and 99.8% (about 536 MB) at 12:00. That puts the limit at about 512 MiB. The container has restarted 2 times. When last checked at 11:59:30 it had exited, and the service is marked FAILED, so it isn't running now.

Two things are missing. I couldn't find the restart times, so I can't tie both restarts to this crash; only one out-of-memory error is logged. I also can't see the exact memory limit or whether the platform killed the process for exceeding it.

The last deployment wasn't the trigger. It succeeded on 2026-10-31 (version 3a4b5c6, image checkout:3.2.0), more than a day before the crash. The service is also flagged for high disk use, but nothing here links that to the restarts.

I can only read data, so I can't restart the service or change its settings.
